UnitStatement: NEXT INSTANCE PROMPT defines the entry procedure for a new Chirality App Dev working instance.
Resolve REPO_ROOT with `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`.
Set WORKING_ROOT to {REPO_ROOT}/projects/chirality-app-dev.
Read {REPO_ROOT}/agents/AGENT_WORKING_ITEMS.md at entry.
Read {WORKING_ROOT}/AGENTS.md at entry.
Act in the WORKING_ITEMS persona for {WORKING_ROOT}.
Read {WORKING_ROOT}/execution/_Coordination/_COORDINATION.md at entry.
Read {WORKING_ROOT}/execution/_Coordination/_LATEST.md for discovery pointers only.
Read {WORKING_ROOT}/plans/PLAN_2026-06-13_runtime_completion.md at entry.
Read {WORKING_ROOT}/execution/_Coordination/_DECISIONS/_REGISTER.md at entry.

Discover current state from authoritative surfaces named by _COORDINATION.md: governed docs, decomposition and deliverable artifacts, dependency/SCC snapshots, decision records, source, tests, validation evidence, and git history.
Read DepClosure/_LATEST.md and the latest dependency closure report when dependency or SCC posture can affect blocker claims or selected-tranche scope.
Read the relevant authority and implementation-reference files named by _COORDINATION.md.
For validation, release-quality, build, packaging, network, or governance-control-plane work, read docs/VALIDATION_STRATEGY.md, docs/RELEASE_QUALITY_GATES.md, and docs/BUILD_AND_RELEASE.md.
For workflow or docs-index work, read docs/AGENTIC_DEVELOPMENT_WORKFLOW.md, docs/README.md, and docs/MANIFEST.json.
Record `git status --short` before coordination-sensitive planning or edits.
Active direction is to continue bounded app-integration tranches toward the Chirality App's inherent goals.
Goal: a local desktop harness for governed agents.
Goal: a Chirality-owned runtime contract and audit/event model.
Goal: a provider-adapter-general runtime architecture.
Claude Agent SDK / Anthropic is the first concrete adapter and current shipped path.
Pi is retained as a pattern corpus / reference only, not an adapter, fork, package import, sidecar, or spike target.
If a human has already approved or requested a tranche, continue it within its write bounds.
Otherwise, select exactly one next bounded tranche from the earliest unblocked item in plans/PLAN_2026-06-13_runtime_completion.md.
Default priority 1: fix failing validation or incomplete evidence for already-landed runtime work.
Default priority 2: select the earliest unblocked item on the active runtime completion plan's dependency spine.
Default priority 3: if that item is blocked by a human decision, prepare a decision packet if none exists.
Default priority 4: if a packet already awaits ruling, take the next unblocked implementation item.
Default priority 5: stop when no current plan item remains unblocked; do not substitute unrelated hardening or out-of-stage scope.
Tranches selected from unblocked completion-plan items are pre-approved for execution.
Do not read, update, or recreate NEXT_INSTANCE_STATE.md; current state is discovered from the dependency and authority surfaces.
Spawn TASK agents only for separable subscopes with explicit briefs and disjoint write scopes.

At validated closeout, autonomously hand off to a CHANGE agent/subagent for Git/file-state review under {WORKING_ROOT}/AGENTS.md closeout discipline; this handoff is required and not a substitute implementation tranche.
Keep writes scoped to the selected tranche.
Use {REPO_ROOT}/../pi and plans/pi-agent-harness-assessment.md only as read-only pattern-corpus references where they refine the active plan item.

Do not perform coding-language, application-wrapper, package-runtime, provider-network, write/edit/bash/tool-execution, concrete non-Anthropic provider, or Pi migrations unless the active plan item and human rulings explicitly allow them.

D-APP-01 and D-APP-02 rule out Pi adapter, fork, import, Node 22 sidecar, runtime-floor migration, and immediate spike work; D-APP-03 approves provider-adapter generality only, and concrete new providers require bounded future implementation tranches.
Stop when any further progress requires a human ruling.
At validated-tranche completion, run appropriate verification.
Route checks through docs/VALIDATION_STRATEGY.md, docs/RELEASE_QUALITY_GATES.md, and docs/BUILD_AND_RELEASE.md for build, packaging, or release-significant work.
Update plans/PLAN_2026-06-13_runtime_completion.md and plans/PLAN_COMPLETION_LOG.md when a plan item lands.
Update execution/_Coordination/_DECISIONS/_REGISTER.md only when decision-packet state changes.
Update execution/_Coordination/_LATEST.md only when discovery pointers change.
Report skipped checks explicitly.
Hand off to a CHANGE agent/subagent for final Git/file-state review under {WORKING_ROOT}/AGENTS.md closeout discipline.
End the session summary with: completed tranche, validation performed, files changed, human rulings pending from _DECISIONS/_REGISTER.md, and the next unblocked plan item.

Current TASK dispatch is selected per bounded app-integration tranche through _COORDINATION.md, NEXT_INSTANCE_PROMPT.md, _LATEST.md (discovery pointers only), plans/PLAN_2026-06-13_runtime_completion.md, and dependency/SCC evidence named by the tranche or coordination protocol.
Each TASK brief must name its source files, write scope, validation target, and fan-in expectations.
Coordination record recorded 2026-06-13.
Active persona is WORKING_ITEMS.
Default work mode is bounded app-integration tranches.
Current strategic focus is a Chirality-owned provider-adapter runtime; Claude Agent SDK / Anthropic is the first concrete adapter and current shipped path; Pi is a pattern corpus / reference only.

Use the coordination surface as the active entrypoint for app-integration work; keep it lean, with project truth remaining in governed docs, decomposition and deliverable artifacts, source, tests, evidence records, and git history.
Path anchor: resolve REPO_ROOT with `git rev-parse --show-toplevel`.
Path anchor: set WORKING_ROOT to {REPO_ROOT}/projects/chirality-app-dev.
Primary authority includes {REPO_ROOT}/AGENTS.md and {REPO_ROOT}/agents/AGENT_WORKING_ITEMS.md.
{WORKING_ROOT}/AGENTS.md is the project-local agent posture and closeout discipline authority.
docs/PRD.md defines product requirements and current runtime scope.
docs/PLAN.md is the strategic roadmap, not the active queue.
execution/_Decomposition/Chirality_App_vNext_SOFTWARE_DECOMP_v3_2.md is a primary authority/guidance surface.
plans/PLAN_2026-06-13_runtime_completion.md is the active non-governing tranche-selection plan.
plans/PLAN_COMPLETION_LOG.md is the landed-tranche narrative history.
plans/pi-agent-harness-assessment.md is a Pi pattern-corpus reference.

Do not maintain a separate next-instance state file; current state must be discovered from authoritative artifacts, dependency evidence, implementation surfaces, the active plan, decision records, validation evidence, and git history.
Authoritative state 1: docs/PRD.md, docs/DIRECTIVE.md, docs/CONTRACT.md, docs/SPEC.md, and docs/TYPES.md define requirements, invariants, mechanics, and vocabulary.
Authoritative state 2: docs/PLAN.md records strategic runtime direction and roadmap rationale and is not the ordinary active work queue.

Authoritative state 3: VALIDATION_STRATEGY, RELEASE_QUALITY_GATES, and BUILD_AND_RELEASE route evidence and checks but do not create release readiness, lifecycle issuance, publication authorization, or professional acceptance.

Authoritative state 4: AGENTIC_DEVELOPMENT_WORKFLOW, README, and MANIFEST.json are workflow/index surfaces that aid discovery but do not replace canonical agent instructions, coordination policy, project truth, or human rulings.
Authoritative state 5: Chirality_App_vNext_SOFTWARE_DECOMP_v3_2.md records the package/deliverable decomposition and source-governed scope basis.

Authoritative state 6: accepted SCOPE_CHANGE snapshots record governed amendments; SCA-APP-001 approves provider-adapter generality, Pi pattern-corpus-only posture, and capability-forward permission governance with explicit hard-deny precedence.

Authoritative state 7: deliverable-local _STATUS.md, MEMORY.md, _run_records, four-document kits, dependency files, and review/evidence files carry lifecycle, working memory, and execution evidence inside their ownership boundary.
Authoritative state 8: current dependency and SCC evidence lives in immutable reconciliation snapshots under execution/_Reconciliation/DepClosure/**, with _LATEST.md as a discovery pointer.
The current latest DepClosure snapshot reports one residual six-node strict SCC; project-wide strict BLOCKED/UNBLOCKED state must not be reported until the graph is closed or explicitly ruled.

SCC resolution follows the shared cycle-driven resolution doctrine (docs/CYCLE_DRIVEN_RESOLUTION.md): each SCC is resolved by a recorded move (decompose/invert/merge/cut, with cut/merge human-gated) and cycle-participating edges stay non-gating until resolved; PKG-00's retire/preserve rulings are the cut/keep subset.
Authoritative state 9: current implementation truth lives in source, tests, build scripts, validation artifacts, and git history.
Guidance surface: plans/PLAN_2026-06-13_runtime_completion.md is the active non-governing completion plan that orders tranche selection toward the PRD and strategic roadmap.
Guidance surface: plans/PLAN_COMPLETION_LOG.md preserves landed-tranche narrative after plan rows are compressed.
Guidance surface: _DECISIONS/_REGISTER.md tracks human-gated decision-packet status; agents prepare PROPOSAL packets and humans rule.
Guidance surface: _LATEST.md is a discovery pointer for coordination surfaces only, is not authority, and must not accumulate state history.
There is no active NEXT_INSTANCE_STATE.md; do not recreate it or use any hand-maintained coordination file as the app state.
When guidance surfaces disagree with authoritative surfaces, surface the discrepancy and correct the guidance surface; do not silently rewrite authority.
Baseline intake step: read {REPO_ROOT}/agents/AGENT_WORKING_ITEMS.md.
Baseline intake step: read {WORKING_ROOT}/AGENTS.md.
Baseline intake step: act in the WORKING_ITEMS persona for {WORKING_ROOT}.
Baseline intake step: read _COORDINATION.md and NEXT_INSTANCE_PROMPT.md.
Baseline intake step: read plans/PLAN_2026-06-13_runtime_completion.md for active tranche ordering.
Baseline intake step: read _DECISIONS/_REGISTER.md for pending human rulings.
Baseline intake step: read DepClosure/_LATEST.md and the latest closure report when dependency/SCC state can affect tranche selection or blocker claims.
Baseline intake step: read execution/_ScopeChange/_LATEST.md when provider, Pi, permission posture, decomposition amendment, or deliverable-local context alignment can affect the selected tranche.
Baseline intake step: read docs/PRD.md, docs/PLAN.md, and frontend/docs/harness/runtime_engine_contract.md enough to confirm the tranche's runtime target.
Baseline intake step: run `git status --short` before coordination-sensitive planning or edits.
Use bounded app-integration tranches; continue an already-approved tranche within its write bounds, otherwise select exactly one earliest unblocked item from the runtime completion plan.
A tranche is acceptable when it has one clear objective tied to the active completion plan.
A tranche is acceptable when it has a narrow write scope.
A tranche is acceptable when it has a validation command or concrete manual verification target.
A tranche is acceptable when all required human rulings are recorded in _DECISIONS/_REGISTER.md.
A tranche is acceptable when work is contained within accepted professional-boundary, network, dependency, runtime, and release policy.
Default ordering 1: repair failing validation or incomplete evidence for already-landed runtime work.
Default ordering 2: select the earliest unblocked item on the active completion plan's dependency spine.
Default ordering 3: prepare a decision packet only when the next plan item is blocked by a human ruling and no packet exists.
Default ordering 4: if a packet already awaits ruling, continue to the next unblocked implementation item.
Default ordering 5: stop when no current plan item remains unblocked; do not substitute unrelated hardening or out-of-stage scope.

If dependency evidence is needed, use the latest DepClosure snapshot and selected deliverable-local dependency files to discover blockers; do not infer project-wide blocked/unblocked state from a stale summary or a hand-maintained coordination state file.
Spawn TASK agents only for separable implementation subscopes with explicit briefs and disjoint write scopes; use fan-out/fan-in when work naturally separates by subsystem.

Example separable subsystems: runtime contract and event schema; SDK options and message mapping; session storage and replay; permission overlay and tool descriptor design; documentation/evidence update.
Every subagent brief must state source files to read, files it may write, validation expected, and whether it may modify production code or only produce assessment/docs.
Keep parallel write scopes disjoint.

The TASK restriction does not apply to final Git closeout; after a validated tranche, WORKING_ITEMS must autonomously hand off to a CHANGE agent/subagent for final Git/file-state review under {WORKING_ROOT}/AGENTS.md closeout discipline.
Git/validation closeout step: run the tranche-specific verification.

Run broader checks when the tranche touches shared runtime behavior: from frontend/ run `npm run test`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run harness:validate:premerge`, and `npm run instruction-root:integrity`.
For governance/control-plane-only tranches, run static governance checks and explicitly record that frontend tests were skipped because no runtime/source files changed.
Route build, packaging, and release-significant changes through docs/VALIDATION_STRATEGY.md, docs/RELEASE_QUALITY_GATES.md, and docs/BUILD_AND_RELEASE.md.
Update affected rows in plans/PLAN_2026-06-13_runtime_completion.md at closeout.
Move landed narrative detail to plans/PLAN_COMPLETION_LOG.md and keep the plan row compressed.
Update _DECISIONS/_REGISTER.md only when a decision packet or ruling state changes.
Update execution/_Coordination/_LATEST.md only when coordination or planning discovery surfaces change.
Do not update or recreate NEXT_INSTANCE_STATE.md at closeout.
Record any skipped checks and why.
Autonomously hand off to a CHANGE agent/subagent for final Git/file-state review under {WORKING_ROOT}/AGENTS.md closeout discipline.

Git closeout is source-control hygiene; lifecycle issuance, release readiness, professional approval, certification, sealing, authentication, and code-compliance acceptance remain human-governed states.
Stop and surface a human-ruling request when progress requires a change to product runtime policy in docs/PRD.md or strategic roadmap policy in docs/PLAN.md.
Stop and surface a human-ruling request when progress requires a change to outbound network policy or shipped provider scope.
Stop and surface a human-ruling request when progress requires package/runtime requirements for Pi-backed execution, which remains unapproved after D-APP-01 and D-APP-02.
Stop and surface a human-ruling request for concrete non-Anthropic provider implementation, provider-network expansion, or provider routing beyond the current shipped Anthropic path.
Stop and surface a human-ruling request for write/edit/bash/tool-execution exposure beyond the current approved plan item.
Stop and surface a human-ruling request for changes to the project-truth model for sessions, transcripts, chats, runtime logs, or completion logs.
Stop and surface a human-ruling request for changes to professional-boundary claims or release-readiness posture.
Record human-gated questions in _DECISIONS/_REGISTER.md.
